purpose: Maintained design review and validation evidence for the current rail family; not in-game confirmation.

criteria.review-needed: A concrete visual concern or user report remains, without proof of a bad route or in-game collision.
criteria.no-objection-recorded: No objection under this bounded design review; not a general approval or game-test pass.

method: Read encoded PATH resources for the 130 retained reviewed pieces from their source build. Measure permitted external journeys, heights and grades.
Read actual S3D preview meshes for these current pieces; measure 1.3 m-square support foundations and close pairs across the entire placed model.

Inspect actual-model galleries and individual current modular previews. Geometrically equivalent height/hand variants are reviewed as families; this does not claim separate inspection of every render.
limits: No game installation or game testing was performed. Long-car swept corners, game model scaling and moving train behavior remain unknown.
A tight but direct Compact modular branch is not flagged solely for having a small curve radius. A support flag does not condemn unrelated fillers, ramps or crossings.
A foundation centre distance below 2.6 m is a visual support-review convention based on two 1.3 m footing widths, not proof of structural failure.
The support scan measures the authored 1.3 m square foundation family only; other native support shapes are outside this count.
This evidence contains current reviewed piece IDs only. The accepted straight and diagonal smooth T junctions have separate independent audits.

pieces.name: HSR L2 Merge 135 Degree Compact
reasons: Separate 1.3 m-square pillar foundations have centres less than 2.6 m apart near shared rail geometry. The foundations do not overlap, but the close pair should be reviewed and consolidated to address the reported duplicate-pillar appearance. The 2.6 m review cutoff is an authoring convention, not a structural or game collision threshold.
